_comment: Reviewed no-growth ceilings for the god functions (roadmap 1.1.x item 16.4; score card 2026-08-27 Maintainability 'Upgrade to C+', of which this file is HALF — the other half is one merged extraction, which is 1.1.2 item 7). `lines` is the AST span (end_lineno - lineno + 1, decorators excluded) measured at tag v1.1.0. tests/unit/test_function_length_baseline.py (fast suite) fails when a function GROWS past its ceiling AND when it SHRINKS below it — shrinkage must tighten the ceiling in the same commit so the baseline never overstates the debt. There is no writer: edit this file by hand with the measured value. It is NOT package data (unlike architecture_baseline.json, which maxim --audit-architecture reads at runtime): only the test reads it, so shipping it in the wheel would be a packaging requirement nothing consumes. Note the strict equality: a pure reformat that shortens a function reddens the fast suite with a 'it shrank' message — deliberate, so a ceiling can never quietly overstate the debt. HISTORY: run_agentic_loop tightened 3546 -> 3512 on 2026-08-30 (1.1.2 Cluster B, the first extraction) when sections 7 (CALL STEP CALLBACK) and 8.5 (BIO-SYSTEM PER-TICK MAINTENANCE) moved to the module-level _loop_step_callback / _loop_bio_tick_maintenance in agent_loop.py; mechanical move, section order preserved. start_simulation_mode tightened 3336 -> 3329 on 2026-09-03 (sandbox-launch blockers) when the CWD-relative sim workspace block moved to the module-level _prepare_sim_workspace in orchestrator.py (data-home resolution; the dead data/agents/MaximAgent/runtime mkdir was dropped). start_simulation_mode tightened 3329 -> 3324 the same day when the sim AUT's subprocess-tool opt-in (bash + the new git_diff/run_tests gates) moved to the module-level _arm_sandboxed_aut_subprocess_tools in orchestrator.py. run_agentic_loop tightened 3495 -> 3488 on 2026-09-04 (P21 prompt budget) when the prompt tool-description collection moved to the module-level _describe_tools_for_prompt in agent_loop.py, paying for the roster permission filter, the ModeInfo reserve override and the deliberation-cap override added in the same change.
